title: theoryforge literature corpus
description: A language-agnostic literature corpus consumed by the (deterministic) bibliometric layer. Produced either by hand, from a fixture, or by the parity-exempt OpenAlex adapter (fetch_corpus).

source.description: Where, when and how the corpus was fetched, as fetch_corpus records it (API_SPEC.md section 17). Optional: a corpus written by hand need not carry it.

retrieved.description: UTC time of the first request, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

sort.description: the order the service returned the works in

doi.description: the work's DOI as the source gives it (OpenAlex: a https://doi.org/ URL), or null

references.description: ids of works this record cites
